url.description: The input URI pointing to the MediaWiki page to convert.

output_file.description: The filename for the resulting PDF output.

paper_size.description: The paper size for the LaTeX document. Possible values are A4, A5, B5, letter, legal, executive.

image_resolution.description: The maximum image resolution in dot-per-inch. The argument should be an integer.

headers_path.description: The path to the LaTeX headers, which should be used. May be omitted.

template_map.description: The path to the user template map file. Usually called templates.user.

latex_tree_output.description: Write all generated LaTeX files to the specified folder. If omitted, files are kept in memory and deleted on exit.

use_vector_graphics.description: Keep vector graphics in vector form.

use_mediawiki_expansion.description: Use mediaWiki to expand the templates.

book_mode.description: Use book-namespace mode for expansion. Follow all links but not recursively.

output_epub.description: Output epub file. Only works if packages latex2rtf and calibre are installed additionally.

output_odt.description: Output odt file. Open Document Text (for wordprocessors). Only works if packages latex2rtf and libreoffice are installed additionally.
